context.content: Most keycaps are on groupbuys but you can find some low-mid range keycaps on Amazon and KBD fans. There aren’t a ton of prebuilt 65% but the gk64 kit is probably your best bet. You just have to buy switches and keycaps separately. If I were you I would wait 2 or so months to get a novelkeys NK65 to go back on sale. It’s the same thing as the gk64 where you have to get switches and keycaps separate but it’s much better layout wise.
